region.name: Texas
region.definition: A record is in when the first two digits of NCES's county code CNTY (eye's details.county) puts it in Texas and its point lies inside, or within 0.05 degrees of, eye's outline state:48 from https://eye.jcamd.com/api/economy?op=areas&level=state (Census TIGERweb, generalised 1:20M; response sha256 e43aaa9eecb50a923507578c16309b9b8199b158ed84e138bbb419c654ddbaa3, retrieved 2026-10-18T23:06:58.575Z). The tolerance covers the generalised coast and river borders; the source's own state field decides between neighbours. bbox is the widened outline's extent. Records came from 1826 requests to eye's civic?op=schools: 0.2-degree boxes on eye's 0.05-degree grid that touch the widened outline, each split in four while eye said truncated (0 split), deduplicated by id.

publisherCount.method: ArcGIS REST query on the publisher's own layer: where LSTATE='TX', returnCountOnly=true (keyless). Every row the publisher files under Texas, whatever its status.
